title: purchased as a gift
text: purchased as a gift. I purchased a snow cone machine for a friend who is a military family.  They live in Texas and I though some snow cones would be some fun.  My friend reports the snow cone machine is just a huge hit.  Uses regular ice cubes so it's quick and easy.  These holders are handy while out in the back yard and the girls want to set the snow cones down.  She recommends a holder and these are cute and useful.  Hooray!  I love that Amazon makes it easy to help my friend!

product_metadata.title: Back To Basics 4 Cup Holders
description: Now you can serve snow cones in style with this set of 4 Spiral Snow Cone Cup Holders. They are fun and easy to use. For use with 6-oz cone shaped snow cone cups.
